classification_rule.SAME_STATE: theta_A0 == theta_C0 == same frozen state (forward/gradient rel-L2 on identical tensors)
classification_rule.TRAJECTORY_STATE: theta_A0(t) != theta_C0(t) (differences measured on independently trained states)

metrics.justification: At iteration 1 both arms are at the shared random initialization; reldiff 0.0 is a same-state comparison.

iter15000 states are the result of 15000 independently-trained steps; A0 and C0 are NOT at the same state. This is trajectory divergence, NOT fixed-state equivalence, and is REMOVED from the fixed-state block.
iter30000 states are independently trained; this is trajectory divergence, NOT fixed-state equivalence, and is REMOVED from the fixed-state block.

action_taken: The iter15000 and iter30000 loss rel-diff values (0.0859, 0.0401) were TRAJECTORY-STATE and have been removed from the fixed-state equivalence evidence block; they are reclassified under TRAJECTORY_DIVERGENCE. Only the iter1 same-state value and the causal-ladder SAME-STATE forward/gradient rel-L2 (within tolerance) remain as fixed-state numerical-equivalence evidence.
